question: 统计每个公司驾驶员中驾照状态为正常的比例

question: 统计民营企业与非民营企业的平均资产总额有多少万元

question: 计算2025年净资产收益率最高的前五只股票
query: SELECT s.stock_name, ((f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares) / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) * 100 AS roe FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY roe DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 计算每只股票最近交易日的涨跌幅

question: 查询总资产周转率最高的前五家企业
query: SELECT c.company_name, r.revenue / NULLIF(r.total_assets,0) AS asset_turnover FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY asset_turnover DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 查询2025年应纳税所得额最高的企业名称及其应纳税所得额
query: SELECT c.company_name, (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) AS taxable FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 ORDER BY taxable DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 请计算立讯精密2025年度所得税费用占净利润的比例
query: SELECT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.15) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100 AS ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND r.tax_year = 2025 JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '立讯精密' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31';

question: 请计算迈瑞医疗2025年度因享受优惠税率而节省的所得税额
query: SELECT (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.10 AS tax_saved FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '迈瑞医疗' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

question: 请计算海康科技2025年度应纳所得税额

question: 找出同时满足高新技术和先进型服务的企业，并计算其平均资产总额
query: SELECT AVG(r.total_assets) FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = TRUE AND c.is_tech_advanced_service = TRUE;

question: 查询那些既不是高新技术企业也不是小型微利企业的公司2025年平均税负
query: SELECT AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * 0.25 / r.revenue) AS tax_burden FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND c.is_key_high_tech = FALSE AND NOT ((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE);

question: 分析行业平均税负率与行业平均市净率的关系
query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END / r.revenue) AS tax_burden, AVG(t.close_price / ((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares)) AS pb FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r ON c.company_id = r.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON c.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t ON s.stock_id = t.stock_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON c.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND t.trade_date = '2025-12-31' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

question: 统计学期一中每门课程最低总评折算分对应的学生学号，若并列取学号最小，返回课程编号、课程名与学号。

question: 统计学期一中每门课程的平均考试总评，对无成绩的选课按0计，返回课程编号、课程名与平均总评，按平均总评降序取前10。

query: SELECT c.department_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS active_enroll_student_cnt FROM education_2025.course c JOIN education_2025.enrollment e ON e.course_id=c.course_id JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id=e.student_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND s.student_status_code='ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.department_id ORDER BY active_enroll_student_cnt DESC, c.department_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 查询学期代码以“2025”开头的学期数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_code_start_2025_cnt FROM education_2025.semester sem WHERE sem.semester_code LIKE '2025%';

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程编号最小值与最大值，返回两年最小值与最大值。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, MIN(course_id) AS min_course_id, MAX(course_id) AS max_course_id FROM education_2025.course;

question: 找出2024与2025中同名课程，即课程名相同但学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_diff_credit_cnt FROM (SELECT a.course_name, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_name=a.course_name WHERE a.credit<>b.credit) t;

question: 统计2024与2025学期一中每门课程平均总评折算分，并返回差值，即2025减2024，最大的前10门课程。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, (COALESCE(a2025.avg_total_2025,0)-COALESCE(a2024.avg_total_2024,0)) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024, a2024.avg_total_2024, a2025.avg_total_2025 FROM a2025 LEFT JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 10;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每个学生的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年整体平均折算分，即所有学生平均的平均。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg_by_student_2024 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_by_student_2024 FROM per2024), per2025 AS (SELECT e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.enrollment_id), avg_by_student_2025 AS (SELECT AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_by_student_2025 FROM per2025) SELECT ROUND(avg_total_by_student_2024,2) AS avg_total_by_student_2024, ROUND(avg_total_by_student_2025,2) AS avg_total_by_student_2025 FROM avg_by_student_2024 CROSS JOIN avg_by_student_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025在同一课程编号上通过率，总评不低于60，返回通过率最高的排名第一的课程在两年各自的课程编号与通过率。
query: WITH per2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2024 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id ), per2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item = '平时' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期中' THEN es.score * 0.30 WHEN es.exam_item = '期末' THEN es.score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id ), passrate2025 AS ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT enrollment_id) AS total_enroll_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN enrollment_id ELSE NULL END) AS pass_enroll_cnt FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id ) (SELECT '2024' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2024 p JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND((p.pass_enroll_cnt / NULLIF(p.total_enroll_cnt, 0)) * 100, 2) AS pass_rate_pct FROM passrate2025 p JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = p.course_id ORDER BY pass_rate_pct DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1);

question: 比较2024与2025两年中共同课程里学分不同的课程数量，并返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS common_courses_credit_diff_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE a.credit<>b.credit;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中同一课程的选课人数，去重学号，排名第一的课程，返回课程编号、两年人数与差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, COALESCE(p2025.enroll_cnt_2025,0) AS enroll_cnt_2025, COALESCE(p2025.enroll_cnt_2025,0)-COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS diff_enroll_cnt_2025_minus_2024 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_enroll_cnt_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中课程总评平均分，排除退课，下降最多的排名第一的课程，即2025减2024差值最小，返回课程编号、两年平均分与差值。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2024 FROM per2024 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.enrollment_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_2025 FROM per2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, ROUND(a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS avg_total_2024, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025,2) AS avg_total_2025, ROUND(a2025.avg_total_2025-a2024.avg_total_2024,2) AS diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 FROM a2025 JOIN a2024 ON a2024.course_id=a2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=a2025.course_id ORDER BY diff_avg_total_2025_minus_2024 ASC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分的中位数，返回两年中位数。
query: WITH ranked2024 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2024.course), ranked2025 AS (SELECT credit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY credit) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM education_2025.course) SELECT (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2024 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2024, (SELECT AVG(credit) FROM ranked2025 WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2))) AS median_credit_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学生表家庭地区编号为3的在读学生人数，返回两年人数。
query: (SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3) UNION ALL (SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS student_cnt FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND home_region_id = 3);

question: 找出2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号，且课程学分在两年不同的课程数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.course_id) AS courses_credit_changed_cnt FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id WHERE COALESCE(a.credit,-1)<>COALESCE(b.credit,-1);

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程参与人数，去重学号，返回两年平均参与人数，每门课平均后再取均值。
query: WITH per2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), per2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM per2024) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(enroll_cnt),2) FROM per2025) AS avg_enroll_per_course_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中课程数量差，即2025减2024，同时返回两年的课程总数。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course) SELECT b.course_cnt_2025-a.course_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.course_cnt_2024, b.course_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中课程选择记录中不同教师编号的数量，假设通过课程表教师编号，返回两年数量与差值。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.teacher_id) AS distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 AND c.teacher_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT (b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025-a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024) AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_cnt_2024, b.distinct_teacher_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码去重后，公共的学期代码数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表电话为空或空字符串的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone=''), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE phone IS NULL OR phone='') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表课程名不为空的数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'' UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_name_not_empty_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_name IS NOT NULL AND course_name<>'';

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的班级数，按班级编号，返回数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.class_id) AS common_class_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.class_id FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT s.class_id FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.student s ON s.student_id = e.student_id) b ON b.class_id = a.class_id;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的平均学分，取课程表学分，返回两年平均学分，对课程求平均。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0), p2025 AS (SELECT DISTINCT e.course_id, c.credit FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=e.course_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0) SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2024) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2024, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(credit),2) FROM p2025) AS avg_credit_for_distinct_courses_2025;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中通过率不低于60的课程数量，按去重学生计算，返回两年数量。
query: WITH pass2024 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ), pass2025 AS ( SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN total_score >= 60 THEN e.student_id END) AS pass_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS total_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id JOIN ( SELECT enrollment_id, SUM(CASE WHEN exam_item = '平时' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期中' THEN score * 0.30 WHEN exam_item = '期末' THEN score * 0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.exam_score GROUP BY enrollment_id ) t ON t.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id ) SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2024 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, SUM(CASE WHEN (pass_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) >= 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS course_pass_rate_ge60_cnt FROM pass2025;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中院系编号为2的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher WHERE department_id=2), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher WHERE department_id=2) SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期一中每门课程的选课人数第一名，按2025人数降序，返回课程编号与两年人数。
query: WITH p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT c.course_id, COALESCE(p2024.enroll_cnt_2024,0) AS enroll_cnt_2024, p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 FROM p2025 LEFT JOIN p2024 ON p2024.course_id=p2025.course_id JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id=p2025.course_id ORDER BY p2025.enroll_cnt_2025 DESC, c.course_id ASC LIMIT 1;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分大于5的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_gt_5_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit>5 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS course_credit_gt_5_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit>5;

question: 比较2024与2025学期表中学期代码去重后的公共数量。
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_semester_code_cnt FROM (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code IS NOT NULL AND semester_code<>'' ) b ON b.semester_code=a.semester_code;

question: 比较2024与2025两年共同存在的课程编号数量，以及这些共同课程中学分不同的数量。
query: WITH common_courses AS (SELECT a.course_id, a.credit AS credit_2024, b.credit AS credit_2025 FROM education_2024.course a JOIN education_2025.course b ON b.course_id=a.course_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_course_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(credit_2024,-1)<>COALESCE(credit_2025,-1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS common_course_credit_diff_cnt FROM common_courses;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分在0到3之间含3的课程数量，返回两年数量。

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均总评折算分，排除退课，并返回两年平均值之差，即2025减2024。
query: WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2024 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2024 FROM s2024 GROUP BY course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.course_id, e.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.course_id, e.student_id), a2025 AS (SELECT course_id, AVG(total_score) AS avg_total_course_2025 FROM s2025 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2025) FROM a2025) - (SELECT AVG(avg_total_course_2024) FROM a2024),2) AS diff_avg_total_score_2025_minus_2024;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中电话为空或空字符串的教师数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中学分为0的课程数量，返回两年数量。
query: SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_0_course_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit=0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_0_course_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit=0;

question: 比较2024与2025课程表中院系编号在两年都存在的部门，返回这些院系编号及两年课程数差值，即2025减2024。
query: WITH c2024 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course GROUP BY department_id), c2025 AS (SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course GROUP BY department_id) SELECT c2025.department_id, c2024.cnt_2024, c2025.cnt_2025, c2025.cnt_2025-c2024.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024 FROM c2025 JOIN c2024 ON c2024.department_id=c2025.department_id ORDER BY diff_2025_minus_2024 DESC, c2025.department_id ASC;

question: 比较2024与2025教师表中教师工号去重后数量差，即2025减2024，返回差值与两年数量。
query: WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_2024 FROM education_2024.teacher), b AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT teacher_no) AS distinct_teacher_no_2025 FROM education_2025.teacher) SELECT b.distinct_teacher_no_2025-a.distinct_teacher_no_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.distinct_teacher_no_2024, b.distinct_teacher_no_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

question: 比较2024与2025学期二中每门课程的平均参与人数，去重学号后对课程求平均，返回两年平均值。
query: WITH p2024 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id), p2025 AS (SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS enroll_cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment WHERE semester_id=1 AND is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY course_id) SELECT ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2024),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2024, ROUND((SELECT AVG(enroll_cnt) FROM p2025),2) AS avg_enroll_students_per_course_2025;

question: 检索最近48小时内进入太仓港集装箱港区警戒区的船舶，对于每艘船，找出其在警戒区内速度最快的记录时间及对应的速度。
query: WITH zone AS (SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(121.25, 31.6333), 4326)::geography AS center), ranked AS (SELECT v.mmsi, v.sog, v.timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.mmsi ORDER BY v.sog DESC) AS rn FROM vessel_ais_data v, zone z WHERE v.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' AND ST_DWithin(v.geom::geography, z.center, 926)) SELECT mmsi, sog, timestamp FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1

question: 客户购买'The Prophet'这本书的最高价格是多少？

question: 包含'broccoli'的图像数量是包含'tomato'的多少倍？

question: 边界框为(0, 0, 135, 212)的图像的对象类别是什么？

question: 列出边界框为(422, 63, 77, 363)的图像的对象类别。

question: 计算'airplane'对象类别在表中的百分比。

question: 列出边界框最低的图像的对象类别。

question: 计算与street lights相关的对象样本所占的百分比。

question: 图像ID 47中对象的平均宽度和高度是多少？同时列出它们的对象类别。

question: 列出在所有赛季中总上场时间超过 5000 分钟的门将名字及其出生国家。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameGiven, T1.birthCountry FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.nameGiven, T1.birthCountry HAVING SUM(T2.Min) > 5000

question: 列出所有空网球进球数 10 个及以上的门将姓名及其所在赛季。
query: SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName , T2.year FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ENG >= 10

question: 列出擅长左手并且退役后成为教练的门将姓名，以及他之前效力的所有球队。

question: 在那些从未做过球员的教练中，胜率最高的是谁？请提供教练名字和他执教的球队。
query: SELECT T2.nameGiven, T3.name FROM hockey.Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Master AS T2 ON T2.coachID = T1.coachID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T1.lgID = T3.lgID WHERE T1.coachID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(T1.w AS REAL) / T1.g DESC LIMIT 1

question: 列出至少两个赛季输球场数多于赢球场数的门将，显示球员姓名和他当时效力的球队。
query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM hockey.Master AS T1 INNER JOIN hockey.Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN hockey.Teams AS T3 ON T2.year = T3.year AND T2.tmID = T3.tmID WHERE T1.pos = 'G' AND T2.L > T2.W GROUP BY T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name HAVING COUNT(T3.year) >= 2

question: 有多少支球队的季后赛胜场数和季后赛负场数相同？
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tmID) FROM hockey.Goalies WHERE PostW = PostL

question: 请列出曾在NHL联盟执教且已去世的教练所获得的奖项。

question: 球员ID为'vernomi01'的球员在1998赛季有多少场比赛以平局或加时负告终？

question: 2010年完封次数最多的门将，他的接球手是哪只？

question: NHL历史上助攻最多的球员总助攻数是多少？请标明其全名。

question: 获得奖项最多的位置是哪个？该位置最近获奖的球员是谁？请标明奖项名称和球员全名。

question: 在1915年取得最多胜利的球队对阵过多少支球队？请指出1915年获胜场次最多的球队名称，以及对手球队的名称。

question: 哪支球队在2006年获得了最多的队小罚？

question: 在2013/11/03 02:01:01时，哪个站点没有自行车可借？说明该站点的位置。

question: 在2013年8月的行程中，有多少自行车是从Redwood City借出的？
query: SELECT COUNT(T2.start_date) FROM bike_share_1.station AS T1 INNER JOIN bike_share_1.trip AS T2 ON T2.start_station_name = T1.name WHERE T2.start_date LIKE '8/%/2013%' AND T1.city = 'Redwood City'

question: 计算2013年第三季度每辆自行车的平均使用情况。找出同一时期的平均风向。
query: SELECT AVG(T1.duration), AVG(T2.wind_dir_degrees) FROM bike_share_1.trip AS T1 INNER JOIN bike_share_1.weather AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip_code WHERE SUBSTR(CAST(T2.date AS TEXT), 1, INSTR(T2.date, '/') - 1) IN ('7', '8', '9') AND SUBSTR(CAST(T2.date AS TEXT), -4) = '2013'

question: 最热温度是什么时候记录的？如果有多个日期都记录了最热温度，请列出所有日期。
query: SELECT max_temperature_f, date FROM bike_share_1.weather WHERE max_temperature_f = ( SELECT MAX(max_temperature_f) FROM bike_share_1.weather WHERE max_temperature_f IS NOT NULL AND max_temperature_f IS NOT '' )

question: 2015年5月平均湿度在65到75之间时，平均最高温度和平均最低温度是多少？
query: SELECT AVG(max_temperature_f), AVG(min_temperature_f) FROM bike_share_1.weather WHERE date LIKE '5/%/2015' AND mean_humidity BETWEEN 65 AND 75

question: 2013年8月之后在San Jose安装了多少个自行车站点？
query: SELECT COUNT(installation_date) FROM bike_share_1.station WHERE city = 'San Jose' AND (SUBSTR(CAST(installation_date AS TEXT), 1, INSTR(installation_date, '/') - 1) IN ('8', '9', '10', '11', '12') AND SUBSTR(CAST(installation_date AS TEXT), -4) = '2013') OR SUBSTR(CAST(installation_date AS TEXT), -4) > '2013'

question: 2013年8月29日邮政编码为94107的地区最热温度和最冷温度之间的华氏度差值是多少？
query: SELECT SUM(IIF(zip_code = 94107 AND date = '8/29/2013', max_temperature_f - min_temperature_f, 0)) FROM bike_share_1.weather

question: ID为16的自行车是否进行了跨城市行程？如果有，请计算所有跨城市行程的总旅行时长。将时长转换为小时。
query: SELECT T1.end_station_name, T2.city, CAST(SUM(T1.duration) AS REAL) / 3600 FROM bike_share_1.trip AS T1 INNER JOIN bike_share_1.station AS T2 ON T2.name = T1.start_station_name WHERE T1.bike_id = 16 AND T1.start_station_name != T1.end_station_name

question: 在顾客RUTH MARTINEZ租过的电影中，有多少部是2006年发行的？

question: 连续租借电影7天的顾客的全名是什么？
